also: whether you like it or not
whether he likes it or not

terms.gloss: willy-nilly, whether one likes it or not
terms.grammar: two present participles agreeing with the person
terms.comment: Literally “unwilling, willing”. Traupman is the only evidence for the pair. Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.

sources: Lewis & Short: nolo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 111.
